free_parameters.name: q_len
free_parameters.why: query length 64 equals the function's last_q window and is above the dense q_len==1 path

free_parameters.name: bsz
free_parameters.why: the guard depends only on the config dict; one batch element is enough

free_parameters.name: num_heads
free_parameters.why: the guard depends only on the config dict; one head is enough

free_parameters.name: head_dim
free_parameters.why: head width is not part of the guard; a small width keeps the CPU run fast

free_parameters.name: dtype
free_parameters.why: float32 is the default inference dtype and it runs on CPU

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixed seed makes the random tensors deterministic across runs

free_parameters.name: head_id
free_parameters.why: the guard is evaluated before best_pattern is used; the first head is enough

free_parameters.name: best_pattern
free_parameters.why: an empty pattern map selects the function's own default sizes, as in a fresh model

free_parameters.name: kv_cache_compressed_v4
free_parameters.why: compressed-cache state is not part of the static_pattern guard; disabled
